name: @engramer/desktop
description: Engram Store native shell: desktop tray, watch folders, Keychain unlock, and the iOS app.

scripts.ios:dev: node scripts/instance-config.mjs && node scripts/apple-core-build.mjs && env -u FORCE_COLOR tauri ios dev --config src-tauri/tauri.instance.json
scripts.ios:bundle: node -e "if (!process.env.ENGRAM_APP_URL) { console.error('ios:bundle refuses to bake localhost into a store build; set ENGRAM_APP_URL=https://your-vault'); process.exit(1); }" && node scripts/instance-config.mjs && node scripts/apple-core-build.mjs && node scripts/ios-project-fix.mjs && env -u FORCE_COLOR tauri ios build --config src-tauri/tauri.instance.json --export-method app-store-connect
